mapper.sql: select id, user_id, nick_name, avatar, credit_score, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from toy_user
mapper.select: select su.user_id, coalesce(tu.nick_name, su.user_name) as nick_name, tu.id, tu.avatar, tu.credit_score, tu.create_by, tu.create_time, tu.update_by, tu.update_time, tu.remark from sys_user su left join toy_user tu on su.user_id = tu.user_id where su.del_flag = '0' and (su.user_name like concat('%', #{nickName}, '%') or tu.nick_name like concat('%', #{nickName}, '%'))
